children: PRO DEX INC reported full-year 2026 results with revenue of $77.55M and diluted EPS of $4.12, compared with $66.59M and $2.67, respectively, a year earlier, as net income rose to $13.66M from $8.98M.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by a 30% increase in medical device sales.
Orthopedic sales expanded 46%, supported by a product launch and a contract amendment with the company's largest customer covering through 2028.
Repair revenue declined 33% as a key customer migrated from a legacy to a next‑generation handpiece.
The company acquired APM in February 2026, adding precision aerospace and defense machining capabilities and contributing to industrial sales.
Backlog decreased to $32.9M due to timing; management expects most of the backlog to ship in fiscal 2027.
